_note: Patreon英語版（女医）。キーは日本語版と同じ。{{doc}}=first name, {{docFull}}=full name, {{pat}}=patient. Non-sexual intro lines only.
setup: {{pat}}, an office worker, failed his company health check and has to come back for follow-ups. The clinic director turns out to be {{docFull}}, a cool and beautiful doctor.

early: Follow-up for your health check. Have a seat.
late: Your numbers are fine now. You don't really need to come.

early: Let me see your face. Properly.
You're not sleeping, are you? Look at those dark circles.
late: ...Not going to look at me today?

early: Convenience store lunches every day, right?
late: Are you eating properly? I worry, you know.
You can call me by my name, not 'Doctor'.

early: Between us... your results were borderline.
Keep it secret. The nurses would scold me.
I don't say this to other patients, but...
I'll book you the same time next week.
late: Hey... can we talk after hours?
Are you free on your next day off?
I found a nice place nearby. Want to go together?
...Did you hear what I just said?

early: It's hard to examine you when you stare like that.
late: Today my pulse might be faster than yours.
I don't mind you looking at me, {{pat}}.

early: I'll write your prescription. Wait here.
It's a little cold. Bear with it.
Give me a minute to update your chart.
How many times a week do you exercise?
late: There's more and more I can't write in your chart.
I always give you the last slot of the day, {{pat}}.

early: Patients who don't listen are a real handful.
late: Don't look up at me with that face.
I'm not letting you get away today.

early: It's so hot. The AC broke down.
I'm taking off my coat for a bit.
late: Without the coat, I'm not your doctor anymore.

early: I'm in the middle of changing.
late: You're the only one I'd show this to.
I told you, no need to knock today.
It's embarrassing, but I don't hate it.

early: When do you want your next appointment?
late: You can visit me even without an appointment.
Hey... what do you think of me?

early: Just a quick break... so many patients today.
You caught me. The director, slacking off.
late: Want to sit next to me?
I can't keep my guard up around you, {{pat}}.

early: Mind if I close my eyes for a moment?
I just finished a night shift...
late: Will you stay with me until I wake up?

early: I love the sky at this time of day.
Are you getting enough rest lately?
late: Want to meet somewhere outside the clinic?
Once you're cured, you'll stop coming, won't you?
Maybe today it's my turn to be examined.
Too close? I'm doing it on purpose.

early: You're anemic. Lie down for a bit.
Do you like your omelet sweet?
late: I made a lunch for you too, {{pat}}.
Want me to make you one every day?

early: Shirt off. I need to listen to your chest.
late: Today it's my turn to be shy.

early: My shoulders... being director is tough.
late: Finally, just the two of us.

afterword.text: And then, we had SO much sex.
